name: Rusty Kaspa
summary: Current stable node and SDK baseline. The stable branch equals cfafeb4; master is newer development code.

name: Kaspa WASM SDK
summary: Maintained browser and Node SDK in the rusty-kaspa monorepo; the project pin matches the current stable release.

name: SilverScript
summary: High-level covenant language compiling to Kaspa Script. The project pin matches RC1; master is three commits newer.

name: Argent
summary: Actor and multi-contract compiler targeting SilverScript. No release or tag; upstream explicitly says it is not release-ready.

name: KIP-17 / KIP-20 covenants
summary: Consensus and script rules for native covenant identity and state transitions; distinct from KRC indexer accounting.

name: Kasplex KRC-20 indexer
summary: Interprets KRC inscription operations and derives token state off-chain. Kaspa consensus validates only the underlying transactions.

name: Kasplex Kiwi SDK
summary: Wallet integration toolkit with node and KRC helpers. KRC balances and validity still depend on Kasplex indexer semantics.

name: Kaspa Wallet Standard
summary: Independent provider discovery and signing proposal. No release; official KIP ratification was not verified.

name: Kaspire wallet/provider
summary: Open-source wallet and concrete provider test target. Its APIs are project-specific until shared-standard compatibility is proven.

name: KasWare wallet extension
summary: Injected browser wallet implementation. Use a wallet-specific adapter and capability-test signing methods.
